ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Admin password for the web UI login. Set it during 'Deploy to Cloudflare' setup, or later via `wrangler secret put ADMIN_TOKEN`. You can change it anytime in the web UI Settings page.

CFG.description: KV namespace for sessions, channel secrets and notification state. Auto-provisioned by the 'Deploy to Cloudflare' button.

DB.description: D1 database for eSIM records and notification history. Auto-provisioned by the 'Deploy to Cloudflare' button; tables are created automatically on first request.

description: Personal eSIM manager — Cloudflare Workers + D1 + KV
name: esiminder
